name: Games By MaxPro
summary: This uses the MaxPro device or Oculus controls to fly your Air Runner ship through 4 exciting levels!  Each level has different and unique challenges for you to overcome.  There are 5 difficulties, 4 different levels and 25 knob resistance levels on the MaxPro for you to master your workout.  If you don't own a MaxPro, that's okay too, we have support for native Oculus controls so you won't miss out on any of the action!
